title: Test Runs panel opens on the Active view by default
outcome: When the Test Runs panel opens, the View selector starts on Active rather than History; the user can still switch to History or Needs attention. Opening the panel for a specific run (from a transcript card) still shows that run's details even when it is finished. Greg, 2026-11-20, relayed by Engram::Asistant in TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2136: '1. czy default moze byc Active ?'. Today ui/src/panels/TestRunsPanel.tsx:22 initialises the view to "history".
acceptance: Opening the Test Runs panel shows the Active view selected and lists only active runs; History and Needs attention remain selectable and behave as before.
Opening the panel for a specific run (initialRun from a transcript card) still shows that run's details, including a finished run that the Active view does not list.
Behavioural vitest tests cover the default view and the initialRun case; `cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit` is clean.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
